top_signals.title: Harvard endowment returns surge on back of AI and SpaceX investments
top_signals.summary: Ivy League university’s $68bn fund gained 27.1% in its second-best annual performance on record as private capital holdings rebound
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bond Traders Eclipsed by Equities in a Rare Reversal
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." As Wall Street’s fixed-income desks struggled in the third quarter, their rivals in equities seized a rare opening to outshine their market brethren.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
